notes.title: Big Machines Take Over the Fields - Pure Farming 2018 Largest Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29502069/a6e41ca2f1bcf85267df37356af71ce568d155ab.png[/img]
[b]If you want to farm hard - you have to farm BIG![/b] And now you get all the equipment need.
We're pleased to announce that the [b]Big Machines Update (ver. 1.4)[/b] for Pure Farming 2018 is live right now.

On top of major tweaks and fixes to gameplay, AI, visual presentation and overall game functionality, the free update brings five new licensed machines - and they are HUGE!

The Big Machines Update delivers 3 new machines from [b]Deutz-Fahr[/b] and 2 from [b]Dewulf[/b]: 
[list]
[*] tractor Deutz-Fahr Agrotron 6165
[*] tractor Deutz-Fahr Agrotron 9340 TTV
[*] combine harvester Deutz-Fahr C9206 with two different headers
[*] potato harvester Dewulf Kwatro
[*] potato harvester Dewulf RA3060
[/list]

Other improvements include the [b]ability to grow grass on fields, improved lighting, enhanced AI of hired workers[/b], night vision mode for the drone, advanced driving physics, option to sell your fields or building, and many more. 

See you in the countryside!
[i]Pure Farming Team[/i]


Full changelist:
[list]
[*] NEW CONTENT: Deutz-Fahr Pack (Series 6: 6165 Agrotron, Series 9: 9340 Agrotron TTV, C9206, DH720A and DH900A), Dewulf Pack: Kwatro and RA3060, Homemade fuel trailer, Growing grass on fields, Farmer's pocket light, Drone night vision, Selling of owned fields and buildings
[*] Implemented additional improvements and fixes to worker AI including worker leaving field after job 
[*] Implemented AI worker support for Versatile 4WD
[*] Implemented various performance improvements
[*] Added purchase maximum value option for various purchases
[*] Changed vehicle fueling method - "press and hold"
[*] Added fields flashing yellow when AI helpers are working on them
[*] Added fields flashing green when AI helper is waiting to unload crops
[*] Added new NPC scenes that differ between day and night
[*] Added new weather effects - storms, wind and fog that takes into account time of day and weather
[*] Added new environment effects - butterflies, moths, fireflies, dandelions
[*] Added toggleable dust option
[*] Added toggleable vehicle dirt option
[*] Added toggleable crop withering option
[*] Improved visual time of day changes
[*] Improved the visibility of sunrises and sunsets
[*] Introduced a series of graphic design changes
[*] Fixed and redesigned fertilizing system
[*] Implemented small changes on various maps to improve player and AI navigation
[*] Improved drone - drone displays more information and allows teleporting to highlighted vehicles
[*] Implemented AI support for growing and harvesting grass on fields
[*] Fixed an issue that made it appear that AI workers are no longer working when viewed from a distance
[*] Fixed several issues with the Akpil Kartoffel
[*] Rebalanced and improved certain elements within the potato cultivation process
[*] Rebalanced greenhouse cultivation
[*] Increased the capacity of the Wielton Strong Master trailer
[*] Rebalanced the compatibility of certain tractors and devices
[*] Rebalanced the speeds of certain vehicles on various surfaces
[*] Added location information in prompts regarding spoiling crops
[*] Added crop names on field labels
[*] Improved visual indications of fertilized and watered field status
[*] Changed the appearance of rotten potatoes for better identification
[*] Added UI elements in main menu to indicate it is scrollable in certain language versions
[*] Fixed sound levels of vehicles driven by AI helpers
[*] Fixed issue that caused certain sounds to be played when sound was disabled
[*] Fixed bug that caused player character to not be visible in vehicle viewed from drone
[*] Fixed bug that prevented the player from teleporting sets of vehicles consisting of harvesters and trailers
[*] Devices on the minimap can be filtered by type
[*] Implemented an altered version of time skip in campaign 
[*] Implemented the ability to grow crops without having to plow during every cultivation cycle
[*] Added camera zoom for player character
[*] Added fullscreen map mode on tablet
[*] Removed gray bar from HUD
[*] Some entries in the Encyclopedia have been corrected
[*] Added mirror support for mods
[*] New modded device category: Plows
[*] Implemented Logitech Driving Force GT steering wheel support
[*] Implemented simultaneous control with several input devices (steering wheel, controller, keyboard and mouse)
[*] Added in-game steering wheel sensitivity calibration - steering wheel range
[*] Saitek Side Panel now useable with other steering wheels
[*] Recalibrated supported steering wheel dead zones 
[*] Added importer of custom shirts
[*] Fixes and improvements to the mod importer
[*] Added Steam Workshop support for imported characters
[*] Fixed subscribed mods disappearing randomly from importer list
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2.5 is live now![*Edit]
notes.content:
[b]Hello Farmers,[/b]

Today we released a brand new hotfix, codename [b]1.3.2.5[/b]. There are 3 main changes listed down below, so check them out now:

[list][*]Fixed an issue that prevented liquid fertilizer from covering 100% of a field.
[*]Fixed selling price of owned DLC vehicles.
[*]Various mod importer fixes to make importing animations easier[/list]

There are some additional decorations in the game, which we added to prepare ourselves for the upcoming Halloween event. We will give you more details about it when we are closer to the spookiest time of the year. Stay tuned!

[h1][*Edit][/h1]
[b]Hotfix 1.3.2.6 is live![/b]
Fixed a crash in certain language versions caused by an incorrect pad vibration parameter.

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]Kris[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29502069/7836a56212a8cdbc70f5bc545684cc17f63dc54c.png[/img]

Pure Farming update 1.1.4 is now available. Again, we have focused on fixes and improvements request by players.

Here is the full list of bug fixes and feature changes.

Bug Fixes

The AI should no longer leave unworked strips on the field.
The AI should now turn around halfway across the field if the other half doesn't need to be worked on.
An AI using a baler should now work properly, no longer stopping after just one strip.
Fixed problems with key mapping.
Fixed the potato storehouse animation.
Fixed the display of vehicle coordinates in the travel menu.
Fixed the display of the amount of grain being sold using the tablet.
Fixed a bug with unloading eggs from the trailer.
Fixed a bug where vehicles transported to another country drove more slowly.
Fixed the option to pay off a loan in installments.
Fixed a bug that caused inputs to disappear after changing the controller to keyboard+mouse using F6.
Fixed the camera when moving from vehicle to vehicle and when changing views.
Fixed the scope of work done by the "Sipma Boryna" and the "Sipma Antek".
Fixed the potato storehouse audio.
Fixed the animation of unloading potatoes from the trailer.
Added information on machine capacity in the tablet.
Audio fixes - removed excess noise from machine sound effects.
Several fixes have been introduced regarding collisions on the maps.
Visual improvements of terrain (optimized textures).
Gameplay balance has been improved.
The Easter egg hunt event has finished - sapphires are back.

Gameplay Changes

An option to turn on real mirrors in vehicles has been added.
An option to configure the driver in vehicles has been added to the Importer. Now you can set arm and leg parameters for the driver's model. The driver will move their hands during turns.
The Importer UI has been optimized.
A function for automatically aligning the wheels has been added to the importer.
A sound effect has been added for the conveyor belt when loading potatoes.
An option has been added to change the tips being displayed when loading a game.
A new look for the radio options menu has been introduced.
